pairs.why: A's door has the real card's two lower panels, fuller ivy and a softer, calmer painted finish, while B looks a little thinner and more plastic.
B's door, with its panelled lower half, smaller wreath and thick ivy, is closer to the real card's balance of colour and layout than A's oversized wreath and planked door.
A's pump is simpler and softer with a matte orange-red body, closer to the real card than B's busier, more detailed and more polished build.
B keeps a mostly red body with the readout and gauge set into it as separate parts, like the real pump, while A covers the front with a large cream panel that changes the main colour areas.
B is glossier and more saturated, and its extra barrel and rocks pull it away from the real card, while A's matte, calmer paint and simpler setting are much closer.
A's foliage is slightly deeper green, its spiral is rounder and its sky calmer, closer to the real dense dark topiary than B's yellow-green leaves and bright cyan sky.
A's tiers are fuller, rounder and slightly darker green, nearer the real topiary's mass than B's narrower, more lime-coloured spiral.
A's broader, deeper-green spiral fits the real card's dense rounded tiers slightly better than B's brighter, more saturated version.
